slides.texte_overlay:
How to turn your life around
in 90 days

Weeks 1-4 | Body:
•Train three times a week.
•Walk 30 minutes daily.
•Cook most of your meals.
•Same wake-up time.

Weeks 5-8 | Skill:
•Pick one skill that matters.
•Practice it an hour a day.
•Ask someone better for feedback.
•Track your progress.

Weeks 9-12 | People:
•Reconnect with three old friends.
•Join one new group or class.
•Thank someone who helped you.

Every day | Mind:
•Ten pages of a book.
•One new idea.
•Three lines in a journal.
